summary: NICE Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing an update to the date of its special general meeting of shareholders originally scheduled for May 28, 2026, now moved to June 2, 2026 due to administrative considerations. The record date remains April 30, 2026; previously submitted proxy/voting instructions remain valid. Cut-off dates for electronic voting, proxy cards, and ADS holder voting instructions are provided. This is a routine administrative schedule change with no merger, acquisition, or other special situation disclosed. There are no deal terms or financial details to report; the filing merely adjusts a meeting date and confirms voting mechanics.
